### 1 of 1. 1 heading in docs/setup.md ends with a period

### What was found
The title on line 1 of docs/setup.md reads `# Widget setup.` with a period at the end. No other card covers this file.

### Why it matters
This project's own rule says headings in the docs folder should not end with a period. The rule is in the `## housekeeping` section of .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md. No links point to this heading, so changing it breaks nothing.

### What happens if you accept
The period is removed, so line 1 becomes `# Widget setup`. The change is made in a separate working copy. You receive one pull request, a proposed change you can review and then merge, opened against the default branch. Your current checkout's files stay as they are.

Pick one:
1. [ ] Fix - Build this class in its own worktree and open its own pushed PR against the default branch; leave the primary's tracked files unchanged. [recommended]
2. [ ] Ticket - file one ticket listing them and change nothing now
3. [ ] Ignore - leave them as they are
